description: Pipeline board UI (Kanban with drag-and-drop), list view, timeline view, and detail drawer. Add /tracker to Nav. Update JobCard STATUS_OPTIONS and ARCHIVED_STATUSES.
steps: Update src/components/Nav.tsx: add { href: '/tracker', label: 'Tracker' } to NAV_LINKS array (after Jobs)

Update src/components/JobCard.tsx: extend STATUS_OPTIONS array to include all new statuses (researching, screening, final-round, negotiating, accepted, withdrawn) with appropriate colors. Add 'withdrawn' to ARCHIVED_STATUSES.
Update src/app/jobs/page.tsx: add 'withdrawn' to ARCHIVED_STATUSES constant
Create src/app/tracker/page.tsx - Main tracker page with three view tabs: Pipeline (Kanban), List, Timeline. Uses 'use client' directive.

Create src/components/tracker/PipelineBoard.tsx - Kanban board with columns for each status stage. Cards are draggable between columns. Each card shows: job title, company, priority indicator, days-in-stage badge, next action text. Dragging a card to a new column calls PATCH /api/jobs/[id] with new status (which auto-logs the ApplicationEvent). Use HTML5 Drag and Drop API (no external library needed).
Create src/components/tracker/PipelineCard.tsx - Individual card component for the kanban board with priority color coding, days-in-stage calculation, and compact layout
Create src/components/tracker/ListView.tsx - Table view with sortable columns (company, title, status, applied date, last activity, next action, priority). Include bulk action checkboxes.

Create src/components/tracker/TimelineView.tsx - Vertical timeline of ApplicationEvents across all jobs, filterable by job/event type/date range. Shows event type icon, timestamp, job title, and description.

Create src/components/tracker/DetailDrawer.tsx - Slide-over drawer that opens when clicking a job card. Has tabs: Timeline (events for this job), Interviews, Contacts, Follow-ups, Documents. Each tab fetches relevant data from API routes.
Create src/components/tracker/InterviewsTab.tsx - CRUD interface for interviews within the detail drawer. Add/edit interview form with type, date, interviewers, location/link, notes, outcome.
Create src/components/tracker/ContactsTab.tsx - CRUD interface for contacts linked to this job. Shows linked contacts, allows adding new contacts or linking existing ones.
Create src/components/tracker/FollowUpsTab.tsx - CRUD interface for follow-ups. Shows list with due dates, priority badges, completion toggle. Add new follow-up form.
Create src/components/tracker/DocumentsTab.tsx - Read-only view showing linked ApplicationPackages and ResumeProjects for this job (fetched from existing APIs).
All components must use extractErrorMessage for error handling, be accessible (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, semantic HTML), and use Tailwind CSS consistent with existing design patterns
Ensure the zero-state experience works well - when there are no jobs at all, show helpful empty state messaging
acceptance_criteria: JobCard STATUS_OPTIONS includes all new statuses with color coding
ARCHIVED_STATUSES includes 'withdrawn' in both JobCard.tsx and jobs/page.tsx
Pipeline board renders columns for each stage
Drag-and-drop between columns triggers status update API call
Detail drawer opens with tabbed interface showing Timeline, Interviews, Contacts, Follow-ups, Documents
List view shows sortable table with all columns
Timeline view shows events with filtering
All UI is accessible with ARIA attributes and keyboard navigation
findings: React 19 strict linting requires cancellation pattern (let cancelled = false) inside useEffect for async data fetching rather than calling useCallback-wrapped fetch functions directly in effects. The react-hooks/set-state-in-effect and react-hooks/refs rules are very strict. Pre-existing test failure in llm-parse-job.test.ts (mock issue with MAX_USER_INPUT_LENGTH) is not related to changes.
